name: M6.Transfer.memory_forced
statement: ∀ (R N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (p : M6.Transfer.ClosedWalk R N) (i : ZMod N) (j : Fin R), p.val.1 i j = M6.Transfer.labels p (i - (j.val + 1 : ℕ))

theorem M6.Transfer.shift_coordinates : ∀ (R : ℕ) (m : M6.Transfer.Memory (R+1)) (t : M6.Transfer.Bit), M6.Transfer.shift m t 0 = t ∧ ∀ j : Fin R, M6.Transfer.shift m t j.succ = m j.castSucc := by
  intro R m t
  constructor
  · rfl
  · intro j

guidance:
Induct on j.val (or Fin.induction), uniformly over i. Apply p.property at i-1 and congrArg coordinate, unfold shift. Coordinate zero reads the preceding label; larger coordinates reduce to previous memory coordinate. ZMod subtraction/group arithmetic closes index equality. The argument uses labels on the fixed indexed cycle, never rotation quotient. Return only tactic lines without leading by. Exact fixed definitions:
import Mathlib

namespace M6.Transfer
abbrev Bit := ZMod 2
abbrev Memory (R : ℕ) := Fin R → Bit
abbrev Input (N : ℕ) := ZMod N → Bit

def shift {R : ℕ} (m : Memory R) (t : Bit) : Memory R :=
  fun j => if h : j.val = 0 then t else m ⟨j.val - 1, by omega⟩

def memoryAt {R N : ℕ} (h : Input N) (i : ZMod N) : Memory R :=
  fun j => h (i - (j.val + 1 : ℕ))

def Follows (R N : ℕ) (m : ZMod N → Memory R) (h : Input N) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, m (i + 1) = shift (m i) (h i)

abbrev ClosedWalk (R N : ℕ) :=
  {p : (ZMod N → Memory R) × Input N // Follows R N p.1 p.2}

noncomputable instance closedWalkFintype (R N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Fintype (ClosedWalk R N) := by
  classical
  exact Fintype.ofFinite _

def labels {R N : ℕ} (p : ClosedWalk R N) : Input N := p.val.2

def output {R : ℕ} (c : Fin (R+1) → Bit) (m : Memory R) (t : Bit) : Bit :=
  c 0 * t + ∑ j : Fin R, c j.succ * m j

def cyclicOutput {R N : ℕ} (c : Fin (R+1) → Bit) (h : Input N) (i : ZMod N) : Bit :=
  ∑ j : Fin (R+1), c j * h (i - (j.val : ℕ))

end M6.Transfer
